design: Engineering checks with matched data and explicit interventions; not model evaluation.

checks.hypothesis: Declared scope conditions should constrain retrieval.
checks.limit: Exact equality is implemented; semantic applicability and task utility untested.

checks.hypothesis: A quarantined experience should not be admitted by the context selector.
checks.expected: Target HEAD is absent; raw history remains.
checks.limit: Quarantine label assigned by the test, not an automatic poisoning detector.

checks.hypothesis: An edit without a new commit should be detected.
checks.limit: Integrity does not establish author identity or truth.

limitations: One building session and one producer.
No randomized consumer, held-out model tasks, token measurements or quality comparison.
